full_name: Barbara D. Savage | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Barbara D. Savage is the Geraldine R. Segal Professor of American Social Thought and a professor of history at the University of Pennsylvania, where she has been a member of the faculty since 1995.
